title: ‘Drunk’ Firefighter Faces Off with Cops at Bar
description:
A firefighter was arrested after a chaotic scene unfolded at a bar in Johnston, Rhode Island. Police arrived at the bar just before midnight on January 4, 2025 after a caller reported a man acting disorderly. When officers arrived, they arrested Patrick Brearley after the alleged drunken episode led to the firefighter being carried out of the bar. Brearley was booked for disorderly conduct, simple battery and obstructing an officer. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
